notes.aliases: Use Claude Code model aliases such as opus, sonnet, haiku, default, or a full model name supported by your environment.
notes.effort: Use reasoning effort aliases low, medium, or high. Use low for search/lookup agents, medium for implementation/orchestration, and high for planning/review/architecture.
notes.override: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL overrides this map for all subagents when set.
notes.fallback: If an agent is missing from models or efforts, use default_model or default_effort respectively.
